adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts the recurring-delete path is now inside `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` (i.e., per calendar reference). In that recurring branch it builds `promises` from `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...endsWith("_calendar"))`, ignoring the current `reference.credentialId`/DB-fetched credential entirely. Therefore, if there are N `_calendar` references (e.g., collective/multi-calendar), the same organizer-credential deletion loop runs N times (duplicate deletes) and it never uses the other references' credentials in the recurring path. This is a concrete behavioral/correctness issue introduced by the refactor to multiple references.
